edges.reason: The onlyOwner modifier gates changeOwner on the untrusted msg.sender being equal to owner.
changeOwner writes the _newOwner value into the newOwner state variable.
The pending owner assignment writes Owned.newOwner.
acceptOwnership authorises the ownership promotion purely from the untrusted msg.sender comparison.
acceptOwnership rewrites the owner state via owner = newOwner.
The ownership write updates the Owned.owner state variable.
transfer debits and credits accounts determined by the untrusted msg.sender.
transfer performs the unchecked subtraction on balances[msg.sender].
transfer performs the unchecked addition to balances[_to].
The subtraction mutates the balances mapping entry of msg.sender.
The addition mutates the balances mapping entry of the recipient.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom uses the untrusted msg.sender as the spending key of the allowed mapping.
transferFrom performs the unchecked subtraction on balances[_from].
transferFrom performs the unchecked subtraction on the spender allowance.
transferFrom performs the unchecked addition to balances[_to].
The subtraction mutates the balances entry of _from.
The subtraction mutates the allowed mapping entry.
The addition mutates the balances entry of _to.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed allowance mapping.
approve keys the allowance storage on the untrusted msg.sender.
approve writes the allowed mapping for msg.sender and _spender.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The address parameter is only consumed by changeOwner's assignment to newOwner, so it collapses into that function node.
The lookup key parameter has no independent semantics outside balanceOf.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful inside the transfer implementation.
The amount parameter only carries the value used by transfer's unchecked arithmetic.
The debit address parameter is bound to the transferFrom allowance/balance logic.
The recipient parameter is only used within transferFrom.
The amount parameter feeds the unchecked subtraction and addition in transferFrom.
The spender parameter is only written into the allowance mapping by approve.
The allowance value parameter is only stored by approve.
The owner lookup parameter is exclusive to the allowance view function.
The spender lookup parameter is exclusive to the allowance view function.
The initial owner parameter is only used during constructor initialisation of DeFiCash.
